import pathlib,subprocess,json,os,time,tarfile,hashlib,shutil
root=pathlib.Path('/home/ekhodzitsky/Projects/syom');out=root/'lab/release-audit/runs/candidate-0.9.0';target=root/'target';env=os.environ.copy();env.update(CARGO_TARGET_DIR=str(target),CARGO_INCREMENTAL='0')
rows=[]
def run(name,cmd):
 t=time.monotonic();log=out/(name+'.log')
 with log.open('w') as f:p=subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=root,env=env,stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
 row={'step':name,'command':cmd,'exit_code':p.returncode,'wall_seconds':time.monotonic()-t,'log':log.name};rows.append(row);(out/'identity-validation.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(row),flush=True)
 if name=='cold-proof-baseline':
  assert p.returncode!=0,'Baseline unexpectedly passed cold regression'
 elif p.returncode:raise SystemExit(p.returncode)
# Rebuild unchanged baseline sources in the same target directory; no copied build trees.
base=target/'cold-baseline-src';base.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
archive=subprocess.check_output(['git','archive','HEAD','src','benches','Cargo.toml','Cargo.lock','README.md','LICENSE','NOTICE','CHANGELOG.md','rust-toolchain.toml'],cwd=root)
import io,resource
resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CORE,(0,0))
with tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(archive)) as tar:tar.extractall(base,filter='data')
run('pcm-baseline-clean',['cargo','clean','-p','syom','--release','--manifest-path',str(base/'Cargo.toml')])
run('pcm-baseline-build',['cargo','build','--release','--lib','--manifest-path',str(base/'Cargo.toml')])
for label,manifest in [('baseline',None),('candidate',root/'Cargo.toml')]:
 if manifest:run('pcm-candidate-clean',['cargo','clean','-p','syom','--release'])
 if manifest:run('pcm-candidate-build',['cargo','build','--release','--lib','--manifest-path',str(manifest)])
 cold_binary=target/('cold-proof-'+label)
 run('cold-proof-'+label+'-build',['rustc','--test','--edition','2024',str(root/'tests/cold_stack.rs'),'--extern','syom='+str(target/'release/libsyom.rlib'),'-L','dependency='+str(target/'release/deps'),'-C','opt-level=3','-C','debug-assertions=no','-o',str(cold_binary)])
 run('cold-proof-'+label,[str(cold_binary),'--nocapture'])
 binary=target/('pcm-snapshot-'+label)
 run('pcm-'+label+'-tool',['rustc','--edition','2024','/tmp/syom-decode-snapshot.rs','--extern','syom='+str(target/'release/libsyom.rlib'),'-L','dependency='+str(target/'release/deps'),'-C','opt-level=3','-o',str(binary)])
 run('pcm-'+label,[str(binary),str(root/'src/goldens'),str(target/'rc09-pcm'/label)])
a=target/'rc09-pcm/baseline';b=target/'rc09-pcm/candidate';names=sorted(p.name for p in a.iterdir());assert names==sorted(p.name for p in b.iterdir());cells=[]
for n in names:
 x=(a/n).read_bytes();y=(b/n).read_bytes();assert x==y,n;cells.append({'fixture':n,'kind':'pcm' if x.startswith(b'PCM') else 'expected-error','bytes':len(x),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(x).hexdigest()})
(out/'pcm-identity.json').write_text(json.dumps({'method':'Actual full f32-bit/shape byte comparison, or identical typed error, across committed transport fixtures','baseline':'80c2c33','passed':len(cells),'cells':cells},indent=2)+'\n')
for label in ['baseline','candidate']:run('encode-corpus-'+label,[str(target/('cold-'+label+'-peer')),'byte-corpus',str(target/'rc09-encoded'/label)])
a=target/'rc09-encoded/baseline';b=target/'rc09-encoded/candidate';names=sorted(p.name for p in a.iterdir());assert names==sorted(p.name for p in b.iterdir());assert len(names)==60
cells=[]
for n in names:
 x=(a/n).read_bytes();assert x==(b/n).read_bytes(),n;cells.append({'cell':n,'bytes':len(x),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(x).hexdigest()})
(out/'encode-identity.json').write_text(json.dumps({'method':'Actual full file-byte comparison','baseline':'80c2c33','passed':60,'cells':cells},indent=2)+'\n')
note: Explicit cargo clean on each same-version dependency prevents reuse of stale sources in the shared target directory. Final identity results rely only on these fresh builds.
